item.title: Manage an HStore Cluster with Hubble
item.description:
This guide covers the differences between HStore + PD and standalone RocksDB. For modeling, importing data, and querying, see the Hubble standalone guide. This guide follows Toolchain master.

The main repository’s docker/docker-compose-hstore.yml already combines PD, Store, Server, and Hubble. Follow the adjacent Docker README to prepare .env and generated Hubble local configuration, then start it from docker/; do not maintain another deployment YAML. The settings below explain connection differences and do not replace the README’s PD credential and service-readiness requirements.
